comment: Configuration for the repository's agent work-tracking workflow (GitHub Issues + GitHub Projects).
Skills under .claude/skills/ reference this file instead of hardcoding project or field identifiers.
Opaque identifiers (project item/field/status IDs, view IDs) are never stored here or in skills; agents resolve them at runtime with `gh` from the names below.

issueTracker.role: canonical record for work scope, decisions, acceptance criteria, plans, verification evidence, blockers, and handoffs

authorization.standing: The repository owner durably pre-authorizes agents to create issues, edit their own body sections, comment, add native sub-issue/dependency links on the repository above, and add items to / set status in the default project, without asking first.
authorization.neverAsk: Never ask whether to file an issue or offer a follow-up instead of filing it; verified out-of-scope findings and verified defects noticed incidentally are filed automatically after dedup.
authorization.askOnly: Ask only which issue applies when competing matches or a genuinely ambiguous scope make that unclear.
authorization.notCovered: Releases, tags, force-pushes to main, and destructive project edits are not covered.

pullRequests.policy: Deliver work as a stack of small, sequential PRs, each one coherent concern, landed bottom-up. A single PR is right only when the whole change is already one small concern.
pullRequests.sliceRules: Every PR is complete production code for its slice: it builds, passes the gate of every surface it touches on its own, and has tests. No stubs, dead code, or placeholders a later PR fills in. A slice touches one surface unless the change is a cross-surface contract.
pullRequests.softMaxNote: Hand-written changed lines per PR, excluding tests, lockfiles, and generated files. A cue to split, not a hard limit.
pullRequests.issueReferences: Non-final PRs use 'Refs #N'; only the final PR of the stack uses 'Closes #N'.
pullRequests.retargetNote: Head branches are not deleted on merge, so GitHub never auto-retargets the next stacked PR: retarget it to main explicitly after the PR below it merges.

review.note: An automated PR review lands per head commit, usually minutes after CI. Merging requires CI green and the review of the exact head.

statusSemantics.Todo: Tracked, actionable work that has not started yet.
statusSemantics.In Progress: Work is being implemented, reviewed, or awaiting verification. Review findings and blockers are issue comments while status stays In Progress; there is no Review or Blocked status.
statusSemantics.Done: The issue is closed as completed: for any repository change, verified landing on main with all DoD items met. Never Done when only a PR is open.

issueClosure.order: DoD verified -> close issue as completed -> sync Project status Done.
issueClosure.noDodShuffling: Unmet original DoD items are never moved to follow-up issues to claim the current issue done.

issueBodyRoles.body: Full scope, accepted decisions with rationale, definition-of-done items with stable IDs (D1, D2, ...), dependencies, and the plan including the PR stack slice plan. Long-lived; edit own sections rather than rewriting.
issueBodyRoles.comments: Progress, verification evidence (commands and results), handoffs, blockers, status-change rationale. Append, never overwrite others' comments.
